description: The 16 October kit (before the balance pass), on the 17 October model with the corrected M1 timing (18 October): both duellists move while they shoot, targets jump, and every shot can miss; 100 duels per pairing and per approach (both chase, both keep distance, one of each), with the best-play win rate of the 2x2 game those four make. Hitboxes at their old size.
title: Duel simulation, before
